items.requirement: `<html>` carries the §9.4 identity attributes and `<head>` carries the four `landometer:*` receipt metas
The theme-init script is inline in `<head>` before any stylesheet, resolving stored choice → system, exactly as the kit ships it
The Appendix E token block is present unmodified; zero hex colors appear outside it (build-local layer uses `var()` derivations only)
Every button computes `border-radius` to the pill token (capsule) or `50%` with equal width/height (circle); no other button radius exists
Every `:focus-visible` indicator resolves `var(--interaction-focus-ring)` or a declared local-contract focus pair; no fixed-hex focus anywhere
A global `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` block disables all animation and transition
Interactive targets are ≥44×44 CSS px; user-read text is ≥11 px Latin / ≥12 px Thai
Exactly one `<h1>`; `<html lang>` matches the active language; landmarks present; skip link is the first focusable
Every rendered gradient string equals an exact Appendix A recipe (angle adaptations recorded); no other `linear-gradient`/`radial-gradient`/`conic-gradient` exists
The build-local layer contains zero `!important` and every custom property it defines derives via `var()`
Fonts are packaged/self-hosted; the artifact works with all third-party runtime requests blocked
Public page: title, description, canonical, robots, Open Graph, and JSON-LD present and matching visible content; the URL is in the sitemap; the favicon context record matches the owning product
Share-promoted page: one complete `socialPreview` record per promoted destination, with its rendered-preview test
Every visible control appears in the control inventory and reaches its asserted final state
Zero dead links, empty `href`s, placeholder destinations, or simulated capabilities
Manifest values equal rendered/DOM values for every field both declare
None of the retired v0.8.x color values appears anywhere: `#795300` `#846100` `#686354` `#8B877A` `#B6AD98` `#A59A80` `#9E476F` `#E982AE` `#827C68` `#85837A`

The first-view DOM contains no warning/caution banner, no `role="alert"` outside a real error state, and none of the Appendix D caution-phrase lint list; the evidence affordance exists where claims render

Every UI icon resolves `font-family: "Material Symbols Rounded"` with the locked axes (or an approved registered custom glyph); no other icon set, emoji, or ad-hoc vector renders; production/portable builds load the icon face from a self-hosted subset, not fonts.googleapis.com

No bounded container (card, tile, panel sharing a grid row) overflows its own box or exceeds the tallest sibling in its row beyond the stated tolerance, at every governed breakpoint and in both visual baselines; any enumeration past the §4.4C threshold carries an answer-first summary and a bounded expander
Every rendered capsule action carries at least `--space-5` inline padding on both sides, centres its label on both axes, meets the 44 px minimum target, and neither clips nor overruns its shape

No group the reader has reached is left invisible by an entrance; no group inside a closed disclosure or hidden panel carries the hidden state; a landed group stays landed after scrolling away and back; reduced-motion and no-JavaScript never apply the hidden state
Every icon inside a labelled capsule centres with the label, keeps the `--space-2` gap to it, and stays inside the capsule box; every icon inside a circle action centres on the circle

boundary: Binary per-item outcomes; exceptions are recorded per item in the artifact (this page: SC-02/SC-03 [EXCEPTION-01], pre-Kit build upgraded in place).
